blocks.content: Puducherry's economy is unusually strong for such a small UT, driven substantially by a distinctive tax/duty policy legacy and a significant industrial base — making this chapter rich in comparative economic superlatives.

Puducherry has historically maintained comparatively lower rates of certain state-level taxes and duties (a policy legacy partly traceable to its distinct administrative history as a small UT competing for investment against the much larger neighbouring state of Tamil Nadu), which has helped attract significant industrial investment relative to its tiny size — Puducherry has long been popularly associated with lower liquor prices and other duty differentials relative to Tamil Nadu, drawing cross-border retail traffic in a pattern conceptually similar to Chandigarh/Daman's liquor-duty differentials relative to their neighbouring 'dry' or higher-tax states (covered in the companion Chandigarh and DNH&DD GS volumes).

Manufacturing — including pharmaceuticals, chemicals, electronics, auto-components and textiles — forms a significant part of Puducherry's economy, concentrated in industrial estates in and around Puducherry town and, to a lesser extent, Karaikal.

Puducherry has consistently ranked among the higher per-capita income Indian states/UTs, and its Lieutenant Governor's 2025 Budget Session address (Chapter 6) specifically cited Gross State Domestic Product growth of approximately 44% over the preceding five years, with an average annual growth rate of approximately 9.56% — figures reflecting the UT's above-national-average recent economic performance.

cells: Pharmaceuticals, chemicals, electronics, auto-components, textiles — concentrated around Puducherry town and Karaikal

Paddy, sugarcane, groundnut and other crops in the flat coastal plains, though agriculture forms a comparatively smaller share of the economy given the UT's small land area and growing industrial/services base
A major and growing sector, anchored around Puducherry town's French heritage quarter, beaches, and Auroville (Chapter 9)
Significant along all four coastal regions, particularly Karaikal and Yanam (on the Godavari delta)

blocks.content: ★ EXAM POINT: Puducherry's comparatively lower duty/tax structure relative to neighbouring Tamil Nadu (historically most visible in liquor pricing) is a frequently tested economic-geography fact, conceptually similar to Chandigarh and Daman's duty-differential dynamics relative to their neighbouring states — worth comparing across the different UT GS volumes.

items: Puducherry's GSDP grew approximately 44% over the five years to 2025, at an average annual rate of approximately 9.56% (per the LG's 2025 Budget Session address).
Manufacturing (pharma, chemicals, electronics, auto-components, textiles) is a significant sector, aided by historically favourable duty/tax policy.
Tourism (French heritage, beaches, Auroville) and fisheries (especially Karaikal, Yanam) are also significant sectors.
Puducherry ranks among India's higher per-capita income states/UTs.
